reference_sql:
WITH rates AS (
  SELECT a.variant, 100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT c.customer_id) / COUNT(DISTINCT a.customer_id) AS rate_pct
  FROM ab_assignments a
  LEFT JOIN ab_conversions c ON c.test_id = a.test_id AND c.customer_id = a.customer_id AND c.converted_at >= a.assigned_at
  WHERE a.test_id = 'AB-2025-01'
  GROUP BY a.variant
)
SELECT ROUND(ctl.rate_pct, 2) AS control_rate_pct, ROUND(trt.rate_pct, 2) AS treatment_rate_pct,
  ROUND(trt.rate_pct - ctl.rate_pct, 2) AS abs_lift_pp,
  ROUND(100.0 * (trt.rate_pct - ctl.rate_pct) / ctl.rate_pct, 1) AS rel_lift_pct
FROM rates ctl
JOIN rates trt ON ctl.variant = 'control' AND trt.variant = 'treatment'

solver.query:
WITH v AS (
  SELECT
    a.variant,
    COUNT(DISTINCT a.customer_id) AS n_customers,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN c.customer_id IS NOT NULL THEN a.customer_id END) AS n_converted
  FROM ab_assignments a
  LEFT JOIN ab_conversions c
    ON c.test_id = a.test_id
   AND c.customer_id = a.customer_id
   AND c.converted_at >= a.assigned_at
  WHERE a.test_id = 'AB-2025-01'
  GROUP BY a.variant
),
r AS (
  SELECT
    MAX(CASE WHEN variant = 'control' THEN 100.0 * n_converted / n_customers END) AS ctrl,
    MAX(CASE WHEN variant = 'treatment' THEN 100.0 * n_converted / n_customers END) AS trt
  FROM v
)
SELECT
  ROUND(ctrl, 2) AS control_rate_pct,
  ROUND(trt, 2) AS treatment_rate_pct,
  ROUND(trt - ctrl, 2) AS abs_lift_pp,
  ROUND(100.0 * (trt - ctrl) / ctrl, 1) AS rel_lift_pct
FROM r
